actions.copy_file.description: Create a copy of a file in your OneDrive, optionally in a different folder or with a new name.
actions.copy_file.props.conflictBehavior: What to do if a file with the same name already exists in the destination folder. Note: personal OneDrive (consumer) accounts do not support this option and may fail on name conflicts regardless of the selection.
actions.copy_file.props.destinationFolde: The folder to copy the file into. Leave empty to copy it into the same folder as the source file.
actions.copy_file.props.fileId.descripti: The file to copy. If the file is not listed (up to 1000 files are fetched), toggle the dynamic input (F) and enter the file ID directly.
actions.copy_file.props.markdown.descrip:
**Note**: If you can't find the folder in the dropdown list (which fetches up to 1000 folders), please click on the **(F)** and type the folder ID directly.


      you can find the folder ID in the OneDrive URL after **?id=**, e.g., "onedrive.live.com/?id=**folder-id**&cid=some-other-id"
actions.copy_file.props.newName.descript: A new name for the copied file (e.g. report-copy.xlsx). If left empty, the original name is used.
actions.copy_file.props.sourceFolderId.d: The folder containing the file to copy. Leave empty to browse files in the root folder.
actions.custom_api_call.description: Make a custom API call to a specific endpoint
actions.custom_api_call.props.failsafe.d: On a failed request, output the error instead of failing the step.
actions.custom_api_call.props.followRedi: Follow 3xx redirects instead of returning them as the response.
actions.custom_api_call.props.headers.de: Authorization headers are injected automatically from your connection.
actions.custom_api_call.props.response_i: Enable for files like PDFs, images, etc.
actions.custom_api_call.props.timeout.de: Seconds to wait for a response. Empty: up to the flow limit (10 min).
actions.download_file.description: Get and download a file using a File ID or filename.
actions.download_file.props.fileIdentifi: Enter the File ID or the exact filename depending on the "Look Up By" selection
actions.list_files.description: List files in a OneDrive folder
actions.list_files.props.markdown.descri:
**Note**: If you can't find the folder in the dropdown list (which fetches up to 1000 folders), please click on the **(F)** and type the folder ID directly.


      you can find the folder ID in the OneDrive URL after **?id=**, e.g., "onedrive.live.com/?id=**folder-id**&cid=some-other-id"
actions.list_folders.description: List folders in a OneDrive folder
actions.list_folders.props.markdown.desc:
**Note**: If you can't find the folder in the dropdown list (which fetches up to 1000 folders), please click on the **(F)** and type the folder ID directly.


      you can find the folder ID in the OneDrive URL after **?id=**, e.g., "onedrive.live.com/?id=**folder-id**&cid=some-other-id"

actions.onedrive_checkin_item.descriptio: Check in a checked-out file so its changes become visible to others.
actions.onedrive_checkin_item.props.comm: Optional check-in comment saved with the new version.
actions.onedrive_checkin_item.props.item: File ID from Search or List Folder Contents. Or use Path.
actions.onedrive_checkin_item.props.path: File path from the drive root. Use this or Item ID.
actions.onedrive_checkout_item.descripti: Check out a file so others cannot edit it until it is checked in.
actions.onedrive_checkout_item.props.ite: File ID from Search or List Folder Contents. Or use Path.
actions.onedrive_checkout_item.props.pat: File path from the drive root. Use this or Item ID.
actions.onedrive_copy_item.description: Start copying a OneDrive file or folder. The copy runs in the background; check it with Get Copy Status.
actions.onedrive_copy_item.props.conflic: What to do on a name clash. Not supported on personal OneDrive.
actions.onedrive_copy_item.props.destina: Folder to copy into. Leave empty for the drive root.
ID of the item to copy, from Search or List Folder Contents.
actions.onedrive_copy_item.props.newName: Optional name for the copy. Leave empty to keep the original name.
actions.onedrive_copy_item.props.path.de: Path from the drive root. Use this or Item ID.
actions.onedrive_create_bundle.descripti: Create a bundle that groups existing files so they can be shared together.
actions.onedrive_create_bundle.props.ite: IDs of at least two files, from Search or List Folder Contents.
actions.onedrive_create_folder.descripti: Create a folder in OneDrive, or return it if a folder with that name already exists.
actions.onedrive_create_folder.props.nam: Folder name (a single name, not a path).
actions.onedrive_create_folder.props.par: Parent folder ID. Leave empty for the drive root.
actions.onedrive_create_sharing_link.des: Create a view, edit or embed sharing link for a OneDrive file or folder.

actions.onedrive_get_drive.description: Get the connected OneDrive drive, including its type and storage quota.

 - offline_access
